night.use: Primary background. The logo is designed for this dark ground.

oxblood.use: Brand surface, primary buttons (with cream or champagne text)

oxblood-light.use: Hover, borders, dividers on night. Never for text on night

bronze.use: Secondary lines, disabled states. Large text only on night (3.56:1)

gold.use: Accent, links, icons, headings on night (7.56:1)

champagne.use: Highlight text, active states (14.18:1 on night)

cream.use: Body text on night (18.1:1); light surface (replaces 'bone')
